about.subtitle: Computer Vision, Machine Learning & Deep Learning.
about.bio: AI Engineer at CogniteX, completing an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering (AI and Robotics) at the Università di Padova, with a B.Sc. in Biomedical Engineering. I work on computer vision, machine learning and deep learning to solve complex real-world problems.

education.description: Background: B.Sc. in Biomedical Engineering (Università di Padova, 2024).

projects.title: Visual Anomaly Detection of Varroa Destructor in Beehives
projects.desc: A computer vision pipeline for beehive health monitoring. Detection and instance segmentation models (YOLO and SAM) isolate individual bees within complex frames, followed by unsupervised Visual Anomaly Detection to spot anomalies and parasites at both local and global level.

projects.title: Deep Visual Attention Prediction
projects.desc: A deep learning architecture for saliency prediction based on Swin-Transformer, optimized to extract complex spatial features and predict where humans look in an image.

projects.title: Face and Emotion Recognition
projects.desc: A computer vision pipeline designed for real-time face detection and robust emotion recognition, classifying different facial expressions.

projects.title: Intelligent Robotics Assignment
projects.desc: Development of intelligent robotic behaviors and control algorithms for autonomous navigation and task execution.
